The accompanying upstream GPL-3.0 license is preserved in LICENSE. The FT4 sample originates in WSJT-X `samples/FT4/000000_000002.wav`, generated by its independent `ft4sim_mult` encoder from a busy-band message log. It is **not an off-air recording**. The FT8 fixture is upstream's busy QSO reference, not generated using our selected decoder in this repository. Upstream corpus notes and reference decode tests document its use. Do not claim independently verified capture provenance for FT8 beyond that source.

Both are mono 12 kHz PCM16. Tests zero pad short slots. Expected FT4 texts come from upstream's WSJT-X reference comparison; representative FT8 texts/frequencies are pinned for regression. The first local run decoded 14 FT8 and 16 FT4 messages with the bounded single-pass search; tests require representative messages rather than every marginal decode.
